source_row.extraction_instructions: aapexperience.org/future-dates/ lists blocks 'year / city / venue / dates'; the first not-yet-finished block is the edition. Cloudflare throttles plain HTTP on some paths; registration page is the previous edition until switched, so fees are gated on 'the <year> National Conference'. Abstract deadline is the 'Abstract Submission Deadline' line on the call-for-educational-content page, not the session-proposal date.

concerns: Cloudflare: aapexperience.org answers 403 'Attention Required' to plain HTTP for /conference-registration/ and /abstracts/, and my dev traffic (about 25 requests) made even /future-dates/ 403 for a while. Shell count was 1 on most runs and 0 on runs made while throttled; the last normal run could not be repeated for that reason. Needs the runner probe result before registering; if runners are challenged finish as blocked.

Fees: none attached. /conference-registration/ describes the 2026 San Diego conference (rates $370-$1315); it only names 2027 for recording-access dates, so the family year gate would have let 2026 rates through on a browser fetch. Hook fees_from_pages requires 'the 2027 National Conference' text, so tiers appear only when the page switches to the next edition.
